title: Introduction to Number Theory
intro: Proof methods lead into divisibility, greatest common divisors and modular arithmetic. Selected worked homework then connects arithmetic functions, multiplicative orders and quadratic congruences.

chapters.title: Direct proofs and induction
chapters.summary: Prove that a sequence of integers is composite and derive the sum of cubes by induction.

chapters.title: Division and greatest common divisors
chapters.summary: Choose a remainder near zero and relate common divisors to a difference.

chapters.title: Congruences, the Chinese remainder theorem and Fermat’s theorem
chapters.summary: Solve three simultaneous remainder conditions, then sum powers modulo a prime.

chapters.title: Arithmetic functions, orders and quadratic residues
chapters.summary: Count integers through their greatest common divisors and turn a quadratic congruence into a square.
